Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling northbound through the intersection when the vheicle was struck on the driver's side by a
suothbound sedan operated by Driver 2. The impact occurred in the middle of the intersection. Responding officers
observed that the point of contact and the reuslting deformation were consistent with a broadside collision at the
speeds reported by both drivers. Driver 2 stated that the crash happened as Driver 1 described it, and two
independent witnesses at the corner gave statements that matched this account. Photographs taken at the scene
show the damage to the vehicles and the roadway debris pattern consistent with the reported sequence. A passenger
seated in the front right position was also present in Dirver 1's vehicle and was identified by both drivers and the
witnesses. Driver 1 reported pain in the left wrist and was transported for evaluation. Officers found no indication of
prior damage to either vehicle. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy associated with the vehicle
involved.
